instruction: Love is not a spiritual discipline; it is, in itself, the state of Samādhi. Faith (Shraddhā) and devotion (Bhakti) are antecedent stages; Love is a transcendent state attained only by the most fortunate souls. Within this phenomenon, the lover and the beloved merge into a singular reality, where neither duality nor non-duality subsists. The intellect dissolves, the mind vanishes—this very state is what is termed 'Samādhi'.
subtitle: Rāmaśram Satsaṅg (Ch. Sh.)
